title: What If Your Phone Charged You $1 Every Time You Checked It? #shorts
visual_style: phone-screen POV (whole Short is a phone, no Dave)
sources: S1 Asurion survey 2019 (Fox/KTVU 'Americans check their smartphones 96 times a day'): 96 checks a day = once every 10 minutes awake; 18-24 year olds check twice as much https://www.ktvu.com/news/americans-check-their-smartphones-96-times-a-day-survey-says

beats.text: What if your phone took one dollar every time you checked it?
Because you would be broke before lunch.
The average American checks their phone ninety six times a day.
That is once every ten minutes you are awake.
So that is ninety six dollars a day just to look at a screen.
And by the end of the year it is thirty five thousand dollars.
That is a brand new car every year gone to notifications.
But people your age check it twice as much.
So you would pay seventy thousand dollars a year.
And the scary part is you would still keep checking it.
Because the phone was never free and you already pay with your time.
So next time you pick it up just ask yourself
